tpm.name: TPM 2.0 Bypass
tpm.description: Bypasses the TPM 2.0 requirement check during Windows 11 installation

cpu.name: CPU Generation Bypass
cpu.description: Bypasses the CPU generation check (8th Gen+ Intel / Ryzen 2000+)

ram.name: RAM Size Bypass
ram.description: Bypasses the minimum 4GB RAM requirement check

secureBoot.name: Secure Boot Bypass
secureBoot.description: Bypasses the Secure Boot requirement check

storage.name: Storage Size Bypass
storage.description: Bypasses the minimum 64GB storage requirement check

oclp.name: OpenCore Legacy Patcher
oclp.description: Patches macOS installer to run on unsupported Macs via OpenCore bootloader
oclp.note: Requires creating OCLP USB with patched OpenCore EFI

treble.name: Treble GSI Support
treble.description: Generic System Image for Treble-compatible Android devices
treble.note: Device must support Project Treble (most Android 8.0+ devices)

gsi.name: Generic System Image
gsi.description: AOSP GSI for custom ROM flashing
gsi.note: Requires unlocked bootloader and custom recovery (TWRP)
